title: Great app!
body: Had everything I needed for my recent flight to Miami and I even knew it was being diverted before the captain announcement!

title: Feels like Apple built this app
body: Everything just feels native iOS and designed intentionally to match Apple’s UI style. Plus it looks great on iPhone Duo

title: Excellent travel companion
body: Gorgeous looking UI, very detailed information and tons of nice to have features!

title: By far the best flight app out there!
body: Clean design, easy to use, and all my flight info in one place. Love it!

title: Turbulence forecast is a game changer
body: I migrated from another tracking app to Flying because of all the original features. Love being able to see the turbulence forecast for my flight, and exploring nearby airports, flights and airline fleets.

title: Amazing app
body: One of the best flight tracking apps I’ve used. Great UI and easy to understand! It helped me with so many delays and the airport maps are the best.
